basis: Independent audiovisual model observation, not human listening or production approval

original_result.comparison_reason: FIRST provides significantly better subject recognition, spatial staging, and causal clarity for the mechanical explanation. Its isometric layout clearly depicts why a packed container hides the top surface of lower cartons, showing the articulated dual-plane gripper engaging both the front and side faces to pull the carton cleanly onto the conveyor bed. SECOND attempts a 3D staging but suffers from cramped framing, disorienting camera cuts (particularly the sudden cut to the mast sensor between 06.80s and 08.00s), and generic blocky geometry that makes the multi-surface gripping mechanism difficult to decipher at vertical phone scale.

first.one_viewing_summary: A clean, readable isometric technical illustration clearly detailing how Contoro's dual-plane gripper pulls a carton from under a stack onto an unloading conveyor.
observed_strengths: Immediate readability of the carton stack and conveyor relationship at vertical mobile scale.
Clear articulation of the dual-plane gripper mechanism with distinct suction pads engaging the front and side surfaces.
Smooth, motivated mechanical animation showing the complete cycle: approach, two-point contact, carton withdrawal from stack, and placement on roller conveyor.

defects.observed: Static staging in the first four seconds before the robotic arm articulates into motion.

second.one_viewing_summary: A 3D simulation with awkward close-up perspectives and abrupt cuts that obscure the full mechanical unloading process.
observed_strengths: Attempts full three-dimensional perspective and volumetric depth.
Accurately timed captions aligned with narration.

defects.observed: Extreme close-up on a generic box corner and single suction pad obscures the overall context of a packed trailer stack.
Jarring cut away from the box stack to an unmotivated high-angle view of a vertical robotic post, breaking mechanical continuity.
Cramped framing and simplified block pads fail to show the full trajectory and clearance of the carton being extracted onto the conveyor.

original_result.audio_observed: Identical voiceover and background audio mix in both clips, properly mixed with clear narration and aligned captions.
original_result.source_limits: Based on Contoro's technical disclosures describing front plus secondary surface grasping for container unloading; neither video implies third-party measured cycle throughput or full autonomous success rates.
